mentions.description: A book about how to be an enabling staff engineer, drawing on experience at the Nordic's largest media house, with additional chapters in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: Egoless Engineering, a book about how to be an enabling staff engineer in the Nordic's largest mediahouse. I saved up vacation and took the whole of December off, mostly to relax. But I'm also working on more chapters for my book.
